set.body: Race Grakern against every deliberately aligned correct comparator on admitted Tier-1 public end-to-end and prepared-topology workloads. A win must exceed the declared practical and noise threshold; ties are not wins; aggregate scores cannot hide losing rows. Publish cold and warm timing, scaling, allocations, peak memory, semantic checksums, raw receipts, unsupported rows, comparator defects, and every remaining loss.
set.title: Run the cross-library championship performance court
